'''Chris Matt''' (also published as '''Chris Matta''')<ref name="dt-5078">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5078 Objectiveless-Tatooine Beatdown], DeckTech (Chris "anak1" Matt, 4 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5078/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5078/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018190911/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5078/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''anak1''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in April 2000. He finished 59th at the [[2000 Texas State Championship]] on 6 May 2000, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d692">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ tx-state-championship-director-s-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
